name: clawd-pets
description: A pixel pet that lives in its own pane and reacts to your session: it works while a turn runs, waits when Claude needs you, celebrates commits and passing tests, and naps when idle. Loads v3 pet packages from ~/.claude/pets.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: The id of the installed pet to show (a folder in ~/.claude/pets). /pet use <id> changes it for later sessions too.

sleepAfterMinutes.title: Sleep after (minutes)
sleepAfterMinutes.description: Idle minutes before the pet falls asleep; 0 never sleeps.

fidget.title: Fidget
fidget.description: on: while idle, the pet stretches or scratches every 20 to 60 seconds. off: it only breathes.

openAtStart.title: Open the pet pane at start
openAtStart.description: on: the pet pane opens when a session starts. off: only /pet open opens it.

size.title: Pet size (px)
size.description: Width and height the pet is drawn to fit, in pixels (24 to 512).

petsDir.title: Pets folder
petsDir.description: Absolute path of the folder holding pet packages. Empty uses CLAUDE_PETS_DIR, then ~/.claude/pets.
